title: Injectivity of pair encoding
statement: The pair encoding is injective: if two pairs of bit strings have the same encoding, then their first components agree and their second components agree.
replaced:
The map sending a pair $(x, \alpha)$ of bit strings to its pair encoding ---
each bit of $x$ doubled, then the separator $01$, then $\alpha$ verbatim ---
is injective on pairs of bit strings.
